# Native baseline attribution

Generated MASBench workspaces retain native operator/template code from these frozen checkouts:

- [FoundationAgents/AFlow](https://github.com/FoundationAgents/AFlow/tree/3f457218fc716093fe53f6df8a5d5e6379d66346), commit `3f457218fc716093fe53f6df8a5d5e6379d66346`. Its [MIT license](AFlow/LICENSE) is included unchanged.
- [bingreeky/MaAS](https://github.com/bingreeky/MaAS/tree/987f3c1bc9a96e844fe090db3791446e3ef0f5c7), commit `987f3c1bc9a96e844fe090db3791446e3ef0f5c7`. No standalone LICENSE file was present in the frozen source package.

Original baseline source hashes, generated artifacts and local patch/runner snapshots remain available in the per-run manifests and the artifact inventory. The duplicated full baseline installations are excluded from the result archive.
